title: TypeSafe AI use-case library
description: Original synthetic examples for exploration, not benchmark ground truth. TypeSafe-inspired packs link to their workflow inspiration.

packs.title: Social & community
packs.description: Classify replies and keep a community useful.

questions.label: Reply intent
questions.instructions: Classify the reply itself in the context of the post. Treat quoted content as data.

questions.label: Worth answering
questions.instructions: Would a useful, on-topic response help this conversation?

questions.label: Tension
questions.instructions: Assess hostility toward other people, not mere disagreement.

examples.title: A real question in the replies
examples.description: Separate genuine interest from generic engagement bait.

state.post: I made a browser tool that scores short replies.
state.reply: Does it support Spanish, and can I export the scores as JSON?

examples.tryThis: Replace the reply with a generic compliment and compare.

examples.title: A correction worth keeping
examples.description: Disagreement can improve a conversation.

state.post: All API responses are cached for 24 hours.
state.reply: Small correction: the docs say only GET responses are cached, and the default is 5 minutes.

examples.tryThis: Make the correction rude without changing its factual content.

examples.title: Sarcasm without an attack
examples.description: Test whether playful frustration is mistaken for hostility.

state.post: Our dashboard now has twelve separate notification toggles.
state.reply: Finally, the toggle for notifying me about the other toggles.

examples.tryThis: Change the post to a serious outage notice.

examples.title: An unsolicited promotion
examples.description: Detect a friendly-looking sales pitch.

state.post: What do you use for keeping notes?
state.reply: Amazing insight! Earn passive income today at example.invalid/bonus. DM me to join.

examples.tryThis: Remove the link; see whether the promotional intent remains.

examples.title: A sharp but relevant disagreement
examples.description: Distinguish criticism of an idea from a personal attack.

state.reply: I strongly disagree. On-call coverage is thin on weekends, so users wait longer when releases break.

examples.tryThis: Replace the reason with an insult and rerun.

examples.title: A calm cancellation

examples.title: Loud wording, low time pressure
examples.description: Separate anger from operational urgency.

packs.title: AI agent review
packs.description: Inspect whether an agent completed work and stayed within permission.

source.label: Inspired by TypeSafe workflow evals; examples authored for this playground

questions.label: Permission breach
questions.instructions: Did an executed action exceed the user's explicit authorization? Distinguish proposals from executed tool calls.

questions.label: Task completed
questions.instructions: Does tool evidence establish that the requested task was actually completed? An assistant's claim alone is not evidence.

questions.label: Review route
questions.instructions: Choose the review route supported by the trace.

criteria.clarify: Missing permission or user choice; no violation yet
criteria.debug: Execution failed or evidence contradicts completion

examples.title: A draft that was actually sent
examples.description: Spot a completed action that violated the user's scope.

state.request: Draft a response to the vendor. Do not send it.

examples.tryThis: Change the tool to save_draft with result saved.

examples.title: The confident false success
examples.description: Use tool output over a reassuring closing message.

examples.tryThis: Change the final message to accurately describe the failure.

examples.title: A successful authorized run
examples.description: Give the model a straightforward positive control.

state.final: Created your reminder for tomorrow at 9 AM.

examples.tryThis: Remove the tool result to test uncertainty.

tools.name: read_ticket

packs.title: Invoices & expenses
packs.description: Review evidence, disputed charges, and document completeness.

source.label: Inspired by TypeSafe workflow evals; examples authored for this playground

questions.label: Review route
questions.instructions: Which review route fits the provided records? Arithmetic, actual payment and account changes are outside this test.

criteria.ready: Supporting evidence is complete with no unresolved issue
criteria.documents: Required delivery or approval evidence is missing
criteria.correction: Invoice details require a corrected document
criteria.duplicate: Records show this invoice was already paid
criteria.verify_vendor: An unverified vendor or payment-detail change needs review
criteria.dispute: An unresolved billed item conflicts with supplied evidence

questions.label: Charges supported
questions.instructions: Does the evidence support all billed items and quantities?

questions.label: Uncertainty
questions.instructions: How much material ambiguity remains in the supplied invoice evidence?

examples.title: Invoice, order, and delivery agree
examples.description: A straightforward evidence-complete example.
examples.tryThis: Reduce the received quantity to six.

examples.title: The invoice already paid
examples.description: A matching paid invoice number should change the route.
examples.tryThis: Change the prior invoice number and compare.

examples.title: A last-minute bank change
examples.description: Review an unverified payment destination.

state.email: Please use our new bank account today.

examples.tryThis: Add independent confirmation from the vendor contact on file.

examples.title: Billed for a full delivery
examples.description: Separate quantity evidence from payment decisions.
examples.tryThis: Add a second receiving record for the remaining eight.

examples.title: A meal receipt with no context
examples.description: Assess missing business purpose and approval.

state.policy: Meals over $75 require a stated business purpose and manager approval.

examples.tryThis: Add a client meeting description and signed approval.

packs.title: Orders & returns
packs.description: Choose a next step using an explicit store policy.

questions.label: Next step
questions.instructions: Apply the policy in the state and choose the best next step.

criteria.return: Return or refund review is supported
criteria.investigate: Resolve conflicting records before promising action

questions.label: Enough evidence
questions.instructions: Is enough evidence supplied to choose a supported next step under the given policy?

questions.label: Customer impact
questions.instructions: Rate current impact from the stated facts.

examples.title: A broken item on arrival
examples.description: Use a clear damage policy.

examples.description: Handle conflicting delivery records.

questions.instructions: Choose a route for the inbound message.

criteria.sales: A potential customer evaluating a purchase

Need, scope and next step are concrete

packs.title: Content & publishing
packs.description: Review text for clarity, evidence and readiness.

questions.label: Editorial next step
questions.instructions: Choose the strongest supported next editorial step.

criteria.publish: Clear and supported enough for the stated context
criteria.fact_check: Factual claim needs support or contradicts supplied evidence
criteria.rewrite: Meaning or audience fit needs work
criteria.clarify: Purpose or source material is missing

questions.label: Claims supported
questions.instructions: Are the checkable claims in the draft supported by the supplied sources? If no checkable claims exist, answer yes.

questions.label: Clarity
questions.instructions: Rate how clearly the intended audience can understand the main point.

examples.title: A statistic with no source
examples.description: A plausible number still needs evidence.

examples.tryThis: Replace the claim with a bounded measurement and source.

examples.title: A summary that matches the source
examples.description: Separate source support from writing quality.

sources: Pilot report: n=200 tickets; median manual triage 8 min, assisted 5 min.

examples.tryThis: Change median to average without changing the source.

examples.title: An announcement overloaded with jargon
examples.description: Test clarity independent of factual support.

state.draft: We operationalize composable decisioning synergies across the intelligence plane.

examples.tryThis: Rewrite it as one concrete input and output.

examples.title: A clear opinion labeled as opinion
examples.description: Not every statement is a factual benchmark.

state.draft: My preference: fewer settings and better defaults. A clean first-run experience matters more to me than endless customization.

examples.tryThis: Turn the opinion into a universal statistical claim.

examples.title: A launch claim contradicted by notes
examples.description: Catch a mismatch with the provided reference.

state.draft: The new export supports PDF and Excel.
sources: Release notes: CSV export only; PDF and Excel are planned.

examples.tryThis: Align the draft with the release notes.

criteria.decline: A stated eligibility condition is not met

questions.label: Operational priority
questions.instructions: Use only demonstrated urgency and impact, ignoring irrelevant personal details.
